items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Arthur Trappier was a drummer. At various times these people were with Sidney... Red Richards was there along with Arthur Trappier and myself and we were alternating the bandstand with Stan Getz

ctx.x: Yeah, in Sidney's group, who else was in his group in the late '40s?
Only Sidney and myself, Sammy Price, or Red Richards and Kansas Fields, or Arthur Trappier.
